## Stack Fit

- [ ] CHK001 Selected stack(s) in `spec.md` and `plan.md` match the feature scope
- [ ] CHK002 Generated tasks use the correct project paths for each selected stack
- [ ] CHK003 Build and test commands come from `quickstart.md` or existing project scripts
- [ ] CHK004 Angular features use `ng test --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless` when Karma/Jasmine applies

## Contracts & Interfaces

- [ ] CHK005 API features define exact method, route, auth, request, success response, and error response contracts
- [ ] CHK006 Angular features define routes, component/view responsibilities, states, service dependencies, and accessibility needs
- [ ] CHK007 Full-stack features define both API and UI contracts plus the integration between them
- [ ] CHK008 Breaking changes include migration or compatibility notes

## Test Coverage

- [ ] CHK009 Every Acceptance Scenario has a matching row in `spec.md` Test Coverage
- [ ] CHK010 Every generated task writes tests before implementation for its user story
- [ ] CHK011 Test data, mocks, or fixtures are stored in the path declared by `plan.md`
- [ ] CHK012 Angular UI tests cover loading, empty, error, success, and primary interaction states where applicable
- [ ] CHK013 API tests cover success, invalid input, auth, and dependency failure paths where applicable

## Task Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Tasks are grouped by user story and each story is independently testable
- [ ] CHK015 Parallel tasks touch different files and do not hide ordering dependencies
- [ ] CHK016 No generated task hard-codes paths, project names, or frameworks unrelated to the selected stack
- [ ] CHK017 Checkpoints include the exact stack-specific validation commands
